decisions.reason: As a large bulk container very close to the firm's core reusable-packaging knowledge, Product A fits existing design, manufacturing, and customer capabilities, so absorptive capacity is high and the firm can credibly refine and commercialize it.

Because the bulk-container valve builds directly on the firm's established container systems, the firm can use its related engineering and R&D knowledge to improve performance and customer fit rather than exit after only one year.

The used-packaging take-back service extends the firm's reusable and service-based model in a way that matches its strategic shift toward circular, traceable packaging, making it a knowledge-adjacent offering the firm is well placed to learn into.
